# Core modules

ZEL Core combines Cosmos SDK modules and CometBFT consensus with EVM execution and cross-chain protocol state.

## Module reference

- [Assets and reward configuration](./tokenomics.md)
- [Accumulator](./accumulator.md)
- [NFT module](./nft.md)
- [Bridge module](./bridge.md)
- [Multisig module](./multisig.md)

These pages describe implementation capabilities. A module's presence does not mean every related product, transaction, or parameter is enabled on testnet.

See [repositories and releases](/docs/build/zel/reference/repositories) for source access and [EVM compatibility](/docs/build/zel/evm-and-contracts/overview) for application development.
